# Zentrix Infotech
> Website Development, Custom Software, and Digital Marketing company based in India.

Zentrix Infotech builds enterprise-grade digital solutions including web development,
mobile apps, UI/UX design, software development, digital marketing, and cloud solutions.
Founded in 2025, we have served 270+ clients across India with 250+ projects delivered.
